description: Zones exposées aux mouvements de terrain de type chute de blocs, glissements et coulées (15) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Zoning of areas exposed to the phenomena of terrain movement in the broad sense, on the sole right-of-way of the department of Cantal, and valid on a scale of 1/100 000. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map Viewing Service (WMS) of the dataset: Areas exposed to field movements such as falling blocks, slides and castings (" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS 1.1.1, WMS 1.3.0. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2019-04-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
